Source: Oh spare me, that I may recover strength, before I go away, and exist no more."
Reference: Poloyo ya jufañule minetgot, antes de jujanao ya ti jutalo.
LLM_Translation: Håfa hao’ i taotao, para i ma’åya’ i kånna, antes i man’å’go’ ya’ i man’å’go’ ya’ i ma’åya’ siña’."

Source: But he answered and said, Verily I say unto you, I know you not.
Reference: Lao güiya manope, ilegna; Magajet jusangane jamyo na ti jutungo jamyo.
LLM_Translation: Ma’aseha iha’ña, “Siguru, sinåo iha’ña, ti manengko’ hao.”

Source: But he spoke all the more, "If I must die with you, I will not deny you." They all said the same thing.
Reference: Lao guiya janaguefchadeg y cuentosña, ilegña: Yanguin jumitamatae, ti jupunejao ni jaftaemano. Taegüineja locue sinanganñija todos.
LLM_Translation: Siña i manmanglo, “Si yo’ maole’ i mate’ para hao, ti’otao’ hao.” I manmanglo’ iha’ i gima’ iha’.

Source: But when some were hardened and disobedient, speaking evil of the Way before the multitude, he departed from them, and separated the disciples, reasoning daily in the school of Tyrannus.
Reference: Lao anae palo manmajetog, ya ti manmalago manmanjonggue, ya manguecuentos taelaye pot ayo na Chalan gui menan y linajyan taotao, sumuja si Pablo guiya sija, ya janafañuja y disipulo sija, ya manadingan cada jaane gui escuelan Tiranno.
LLM_Translation: Maole’ na siha na’maole’ iha’ na’ma’gas, yan na’ma’disobediente, na’ma’palao’ iha’ na’ma’gas iha’ i taotao, siha’ na’ma’gof na’ma’gof i gima’ iha’ siha, yan na’ma’separa’ i disipulus, na’ma’palao’ kada dia iha’ i skuela’ i Tyrannus.

Source: Saying, Father, if thou be willing, remove this cup from me: nevertheless not my will, but thine, be done.
Reference: Ylegña: Tata, yanguin malago jao, nasuja guiya guajo este y copa: lao munga mafatinas y malagojo, lao y malagomo.
LLM_Translation: Tata, si yu’ maole’ na’ i cup: pero’ na’ yu’ maole’ na’ i’yo, na’ i’yo maole’ na’ i’yo.

Source: He will drink of the brook in the way; therefore he will lift up his head.
Reference: Unaguimen y sadog gui chalan: enaomina güiya jumatsa julo y ilo.
LLM_Translation: Håo na’ån i batisan; asina, ha’åmån i ulu-hu.

Source: "For I tell you, among those who are born of women there is not a greater prophet than John the Baptizer, yet he who is least in the Kingdom of God is greater than he."
Reference: Jusangane jamyo, na entre ayo sija y manmafañago gui famalaoan, taya dangculoña qui si Juan; lao y diquiqueja gui raenon Yuus dangculoña qui güiya.
LLM_Translation: Håfa i manmåolik, i gima’tao na’ i manåmko’ na’ i propeta, si Juan i Manbaptista, pero i gima’tao na’ i manåmko’ na’ i Kahari’an i Dios, mas ma’å’ulo’ i gima’tao na’ i propeta.

Source: And when he was come in, he saith unto them, Why make ye this ado, and weep? the damsel is not dead, but sleepeth.
Reference: Ya anae jumalom, ilegña nu sija: Jafa na manatborotao jamyo, yan manatanges jamyo? Y patgon na palaoan ti matae, na mamaego.
LLM_Translation: Unu, i manmangge’ siha, i manma’ase’ i taotao: “Mano’ i patgon ni yu’ i manmangge’ un? Ayu’ i babanai, ma’ase’ i manmangge’.”

Source: Very good!
Reference: Gof maolek!
LLM_Translation: Maolek!

Source: yet because this widow bothers me, I will defend her, or else she will wear me out by her continual coming.'"
Reference: Lao pot y jarorobayo este na palaoan, bae juaregla sija, sa noseaja pot y sisigueja mague, uestotbayo.
LLM_Translation: Sige’ na’ i widda’ siha na’ i manmangga’ hao, siña’ na’ i defendé iya, o siña’ na’ i widda’ na’ i manmangga’ hao i manmangga’ hao gi’ su’ su’ na’ u’ma’na’.”

Source: For whoever desires to save his life will lose it, but whoever will lose his life for my sake, the same will save it.
Reference: Sa masqueseaja jaye y malago na usatba y linâlâña, ufinalingaeguan; ya masquesea jaye y malingo y linâlâña pot y naanjo, güiya usatba.
LLM_Translation: Siaha iha’ desiha para i-salba i laifuña, manlos i laifuña; ma’ desiha iha’ para i-losa i laifuña para i gima’gu, iha’ i laifuña hao.

Source: I have seen, and have testified that this is the Son of God."
Reference: Ya guajo julie ya manae yo testimonio nu y güiya y Lajin Yuus.
LLM_Translation: I gimaole, ya testiguåo, na siña i Anak i Dios.

Source: And when they were come, and had gathered the church together, they rehearsed all that God had done with them, and how he had opened the door of faith unto the Gentiles.
Reference: Ya anae manmato ya mandaña iglesia gui guimayuus, masangan todo sija y finatinas Yuus pot sija; yan jaftaemano jababaye y Gentiles ni y pettan y jinenggue.
LLM_Translation: Unu na’ i manmalok, unun na’ i siman i iglesia, i manmalok i tanan i finang i Dios para i manmalok-hu, yan para i manmalok-hu i pinala’ i p’ina’ i pananampalataya para i Gentiles.

Source: And sent forth his servants to call them that were bidden to the wedding: and they would not come.
Reference: Ya jatago y tentagoña sija, na ujaagange y manmaconbida gui guipot; lao ti manmalago manmato.
LLM_Translation: Iya ha’ sentu i man’amensa’ña para tinatawag i man’amensa’ña i wedding: un siña’ ha’ole’ para kumme.

Source: For John was not yet cast into prison.
Reference: Sa si Juan trabia ti mapopolo gui catset.
LLM_Translation: Para si Juan chưaña’ na’manu’ na’guåhan i prisun.

Source: My frame wasn't hidden from you, when I was made in secret, woven together in the depths of the earth.
Reference: Y tataotaojo ti umatog guiya jago, anae mafatinasyo gui secreto; ya matufog yo ni namanman, gui mas tagpapa na lugat gui tano.
LLM_Translation: Håo na’ i frame-mu, i manmangga’ i gima’ na’ i liheng, i hinengga’ i’ gima’ i’ lalom-taotao’ i tano’.

Source: And Jesus went into the temple of God, and cast out all them that sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the tables of the moneychangers, and the seats of them that sold doves,
Reference: N 21 12 31550 ¶ Ya jumalom si Jesus gui guimayuus, ya jayute juyong todo y manmanbebende, yan y manmamamajan gui guimayuus, ya janaalinquin y lamasan y manmanulalaeca salape, yan y tachong y manmanbebende paluma;
LLM_Translation: Iesus guaha i templo i Tåta, unnaoña iha iha i templo i manmanglo’ yan manmabåi, unti’ i mesa i manmangchånggo’ kuattru, yan i setbåoña i manmangbåi i kalåne’,

Source: Of whom I have no certain thing to write to my lord. Therefore I have brought him forth before you, and especially before you, King Agrippa, that, after examination, I may have something to write.
Reference: Ya taya jafa magajet na güinajaña para jutugue para y Señotjo. Enaomina jucone güe mona gui menanmiyo, yan y menamo, O Ray Agripa, para yaguin munjayan maegsamina, uguaja jafa para jutugue.
LLM_Translation: Håo’ iha’ ti siguru na’ i manå’ot para i guå’guå’hu. I så’ i manå’ot i gima’ i gima’ i håo, mås i håo, King Agrippa, para iha’ na’ i manå’ot, ma’ iha’ i manå’ot iha’ na’ i manå’ot, para iha’ na’ i manå’ot iha’ håo, ma’ iha’ na’ i manå’ot, ma’ iha’ na’ i manå’ot.

Source: Thou didst divide the sea by thy strength: thou brakest the heads of the dragons in the waters.
Reference: Jago dumibide y tase ni y ninasiñamo: jago yumamag y ilon y alo sija gui tase.
LLM_Translation: Iya-mu na’na’ i dagat i taotao-mu: iya-mu na’na’ i ulu i man’kakok i taotao i tubig.

Source: If it bears fruit, fine; but if not, after that, you can cut it down.'"
Reference: Ya yanguin ufanogcha, mauleg; yanguin aje, siempre, unutut.
LLM_Translation: Si frutu na’ga, maole; pero si no, i taotao na’ga, potde’ hao para i-katba’ na’ga.

Source: Now when Festus was come into the province, after three days he ascended from Caesarea to Jerusalem.
Reference: AYONAE jumalom si Festo gui provinsia, ya anae malofan tres na jaane cumajulo desde Sesarea asta Jerusalem.
LLM_Translation: Gininåo, si Festus måsai na’åo na’åo i prubinsia, gininåo na’åo na’åo i tres åñu, si Festus manå’åo siha na’åo i Caesarea para i Jerusalem.

Source: But Peter and John answered them, "Whether it is right in the sight of God to listen to you rather than to God, judge for yourselves,
Reference: Lao si Pedro yan Juan manope ilegñija: Jusga, cao tunas gui menan Yuus na inosgueña jamyo qui si Yuus;
LLM_Translation: Si Pedro yan si Juan, na-yan-respondi iha, “Si tama na iyan i-sinibe’ para i God, o si tama na iyan i-sinibe’ para iyo, siyan ija’ i-judga para iyo-mesmu,”

Source: Our fathers didn't understand your wonders in Egypt. They didn't remember the multitude of your loving kindnesses, but were rebellious at the sea, even at the Red Sea .
Reference: Y tatanmame ti jatungo y ninamanmanmo guiya Egipto; ti jajaso y manadan y minaasemo; lao manmanembeste gui tase, junggan gui Tasen Agaga.
LLM_Translation: I tatatåo håo na’ma’å’ma’ i’ tiningo’ i Egipto. I tatatåo håo na’ma’å’ma’ i’ tiningo’ i’ tiningo’ i’ kånåo’ i’ ma’å’ma’ i’ håo, pero na’ma’å’ma’ i’ rebeldia i’ siña, i’ rebeldia i’ siña i’ Dagat Rå’å’ (Dagat Rå’å’).

Source: And it became known throughout all Joppa, and many believed in the Lord.
Reference: Ya matungo todo guiya Joppe; ya megae manmanjonggue ni y Señot.
LLM_Translation: Huli’ na’maole’ i Joppa, un siña’ maole’ i Panginoon.

Source: Saying, The scribes and the Pharisees sit in Moses' seat:
Reference: Ylegña: Y escriba yan y Fariseo sija manmatatachong gui tachong Moises;
LLM_Translation: Sige, i manmanghulu ya Phariseo, maninita i upuan ni Moises:

Source: But immediately after the oppression of those days, the sun will be darkened, the moon will not give its light, the stars will fall from the sky, and the powers of the heavens will be shaken;
Reference: N 24 29 33030 ¶ Ti apmam despues di y pininiten ayo sija na jaane, y atdao ujomjom, ya y pilan ti ufanina; ya y pution sija ufamodong guine y langet; ya y nina siñan y langet ufanmayengyong.
LLM_Translation: Ikao’ na’maole’ i opresiòn i tiempon i’na, i sun willa’ ma’pula’, i luna’ si’ña’ ma’tao’ i’na, i bitu’ ma’palao’ gima’ i langit, yan i puti’ i langit ma’gufna’;

Source: Thy congregation hath dwelt therein: thou, O God, hast prepared of thy goodness for the poor.
Reference: Y inetnon taotaomo mañaga güije: jago, O Yuus, fumamauleg y minaulegmo para y mamoble.
LLM_Translation: Ita congregasion-mu siña iha: Siña, Dios, ha’ preparado-mu na’ i gimao para i manåhongo.

Source: The LORD shall reign for ever, even thy God, O Zion, unto all generations. Praise ye the LORD.
Reference: Si Jeova ufangobietna para taejinecog; y Yuusmo, O Sion, para todo y generasion. Fanmanalaba jamyo as Jeova.
LLM_Translation: I Lahi’ shall reign for ever, i God-mu, O Sion, i gima’ na’ i henerasion. Manalå’ i Lahi’.

Source: And the man in whom the evil spirit was leaped on them, and overcame them, and prevailed against them, so that they fled out of that house naked and wounded.
Reference: Ya y taotao ni y guaja taelaye na espiritu, tumayog gui jiloñija; ya jagana sija, sa mas gaeninasiñaña qui sija; ya esta manmalago sija güije na guma, manerido yan taya magaguñija.
LLM_Translation: I manåo na’ i espiritu malåo si’ña’ i manåo, sinakåo i manåo, sinakåo i manåo, så’ i manåo si’ña’ å’ga’ i hale, håfa’ i manåo, håfa’ i manåo, na’ i manåo si’ña’ å’ga’ i hale na’ i manåo na’ i manåo.

Source: Always, night and day, in the tombs and in the mountains, he was crying out, and cutting himself with stones.
Reference: Ya siempre yan puenge yan jaane, jumajanao ya umaagang gui entalo naftan sija, yan gui jalomtano sija, ya janalalamen güe ni acho sija.
LLM_Translation: Siempre, i gima’ i asu, i gima’ i bundok, i manmanglo’ i manmanglo’, i manputi’ i manhaga’ i taotao’ gi petra.

Source: Ken is older than Seiko.
Reference: Åmko'ña si Ken kinu si Seiko.
LLM_Translation: Ken i mas matinas Seiko.

Source: Save me, O God; for the waters are come in unto my soul.
Reference: NALIBREYO, O Yuus; sa y janom manjalom asta y antijo.
LLM_Translation: Håfa’ i’ måsao, O Dios; para i’ tåya’ i’ åmumu’ i’ soul.

Source: And a fire was kindled in their company; the flame burned up the wicked.
Reference: Yan y guafe manafañila gui mangachongñija; ya y mañila sumonggue y manaelaye.
LLM_Translation: Ha’ i fuego na’ma’kattin i taotao; i apoyu na’ma’kattin i man’kattin.

Source: LORD, I cry unto thee: make haste unto me; give ear unto my voice, when I cry unto thee.
Reference: Y Salmon David. sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
LLM_Translation: Håfa taotao, O Senyõr: gi’na’åo i manmangåo; håna’ i boses-mu, i manmangåo gi’na’åo.

Source: The Jews answered him, "We have a law, and by our law he ought to die, because he made himself the Son of God."
Reference: Maope güe ni y Judio sija: Jame guaja laymame, ya segun y laymame, debe umatae, sa jafa na güiya jafatinas maesa güe Lajin Yuus.
LLM_Translation: Iesu iha na’ iha’ “Iesu iha’ na’ iha’ linu, ha’ na’ iha’ linu na’ iha’ iha’ mate, pas iha’ na’ iha’ Son of God.”

Source: For it seems to me unreasonable, in sending a prisoner, not to also specify the charges against him."
Reference: Sa y jinasoco na taya rason na umanajanao y presonero, ya ti umanaclaro y isao ni y mapolo contra güiya.
LLM_Translation: Para i manmangao’ na un’ ma’ataha, siña’ i prisionero, na un’ ma’ataha na i’ especifika’ i kasu na’ i’ ti’ ha’ñu.

Source: Do you show wonders to the dead? Do the dead rise up and praise you? Selah.
Reference: Ada unnamalie y ninamanman gui manmatae? Siña y manmatae mangajulo ya unmaalaba? Sila.
LLM_Translation: ¿Iyao siña i milagru para i patte? ¿Iyao siña i patte para bumangon un praise hao? Selah.

Source: No one can come to me unless the Father who sent me draws him, and I will raise him up in the last day.
Reference: Taya siña mato guiya guajo yaguin si Tata, ni tumago yo, ti quinene güe; ya guajo junacajulo güe gui uttimo na jaane.
LLM_Translation: Håo’ iha’ ni manenggai para hu’ para i’ sentrát i Padre, si no’ i Padre i’ sentrát i’ ha’ i’ manenggai, un i’ ha’ i’ ha’ i’ i’ huli’ i’ i’ dima’ i’ i’ finál na’ guaha.

Source: She said, "No one, Lord." Jesus said, "Neither do I condemn you. Go your way. From now on, sin no more."
Reference: Ya ilegña: Taya uno Señot. Ya ilegña si Jesus: Guajo locue ti jusentensia jao: janao ya chamo unisao talo.
LLM_Translation: “Siha” na’ “Nadie, Señor.” “Jesús” na’ “Niha’ ma’ kondemna yu. Haole’ na’ i’ way. Tåya’ na’ i’ sinå’ yu, manmå’å’ na’ i’ sinå’.”

Source: Most certainly I tell you, this generation will not pass away, until all these things are accomplished.
Reference: Magajet jusangane jamyo, na ti ufanmalofan este na generasion, asta qui todo este sija na güinaja manmacumple.
LLM_Translation: Most certainly I tell you, this generation will not pass away, until all these things are accomplished.

Source: He was transfigured before them. His face shone like the sun, and his garments became as white as the light.
Reference: Ya jaaggo y jechuraña gui menanñija; ya y mataña manina calang y atdao; ya y magaguña apaca calang y manana.
LLM_Translation: Himaya’ siya’ na’ i manå’lo’ gi’ i taotao. I pesi’ na’ manå’lo’ gi’ i sun, yan i kustombrå’ na’ manå’lo’ gi’ i liwanag.

Source: "We heard him say, 'I will destroy this temple that is made with hands, and in three days I will build another made without hands.'"
Reference: Injingog y ilegña: Juyulang este na templo, ni y mafatinas nu canae, ya y tres na jaane, janacajulo talo otro na ti finatinas canae.
LLM_Translation: Håyi taotao i manmanglo’ i manmanglo’ na’ i templo, “Håyi taotao i manmanglo’ na’ i templo, ‘I will destroy this temple that is made with hands, and in three days I will build another made without hands.’”

Source: You heard how I told you, 'I go away, and I come to you.' If you loved me, you would have rejoiced, because I said 'I am going to my Father;' for the Father is greater than I.
Reference: Jamyo jagas injingogja jafa y jusagane jamyo, bae jujano, ya jutalo güine mague guiya jamyo. Yaguin inguaeya yo, magajet infanmagof, sa bae jujanao ya jufalag as Tata; sa si Tata dangculoña qui guajo.
LLM_Translation: Nahe’yo’ yu’ i’yo’ hao’ na’ i’yo’ na’ “Hao’ guaha, yan hao’ guaha’ i’yo’.” Si hao’ na’maole’ i’yo’, ma’ na’maole’ i’yo’ na’ i’yo’ na’ “Hao’ guaha’ i’yo’ i Papa”; kayi’ Papa mas maole’ i’yo’ na’ i’yo’.

Source: And to offer a sacrifice according to that which is said in the law of the Lord, A pair of turtledoves, or two young pigeons.
Reference: Ya para umanae inefrese jaftaemanoja y masangan y lay y Señot, un pares na tortola pat dos patgon na paluma.
LLM_Translation: Ikao para iha’ i sakrifisio manåo iha’ i linasan i Tåtao, siha’ na’ pairu i manångkåo, o dos na’ manångkåo.

Source: he said to them, "Make room, because the girl isn't dead, but sleeping." They were ridiculing him.
Reference: Ylegña: Fañuja; sa y patgon palaoan ti mamatae, lao mamaego. Ya mabutleagüe.
LLM_Translation: Iya’ na’ga’ hao’g, “Håo’ma’ i famagu’on, esta’ si’ña’ i natula’, ma’å’ i’ña’ i’ña’ i’ña’.” Iya’ na’ga’ na’taotao’ hao’.

Source: Yahweh will send forth the rod of your strength out of Zion. Rule in the midst of your enemies.
Reference: Si Jeova uninamannae y baran minetgotmo guinin Sion: gobietna gui entalo y enimigumo sija.
LLM_Translation: Si Yahweh manhatao i rodun yo’onggu out of Zion. Manhatao i’ na’ i manmangga’ yo’onggu i taotao’ yo’onggu.

Source: But if ye believe not his writings, how shall ye believe my words?
Reference: Lao yaguin tinigueña sija ti injenggue, jafa muna injenggue y sinanganjo?
LLM_Translation: Si yu manen iya na suesus i manmang, hao na manen iya na palabrasku?

Source: "A certain lender had two debtors. The one owed five hundred denarii, and the other fifty.
Reference: Un taotao guaja dos dumídibe: ya y uno mandidibe quinientos monedan denario, ya y otro sincuenta.
LLM_Translation: Håfa iha un prestamista iha dos debidores. I unu na debidore na owed lima-sientu denarii, yan i otro na owed sinkuenta.

Source: The rain came down, the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat on that house; and it fell--and great was its fall."
Reference: Ya utunog y ichan yan ufanmato y sadog, yan ufanmanguaefe y manglo ya ubinate ayo na guma, ya upodong; ya gosdangculo y pinedongña.
LLM_Translation: I rinao na ulem, i rinao na baha, i rinao na hangin, i manakot na i tano’ na i guma; i sinang na—håo na i sinang na guma.

Source: His disciples say unto him, If the case of the man be so with his wife, it is not good to marry.
Reference: N 19 10 30890 ¶ Ylegñija y disipuluña sija nu güiya: Yaguin taegüenao nu y laje yan y asaguana, ti mauleg na umasagua.
LLM_Translation: I manmanglo’ na disipulus na i man, siña’ i kasu na lalaki para i asagua, esti na’ma’ole’ para i manmari.

Source: Whose feet they hurt with fetters: he was laid in iron:
Reference: Ayo sija na adengña y ninafanlamen ni y cadena: güiya mapolo guientalo y lilog.
LLM_Translation: Iya na su tiil na manakot i fetter: na layu i iron.

Source: No man hath seen God at any time; the only begotten Son, which is in the bosom of the Father, he hath declared him.
Reference: Si Yuus, taya taotao lumie, taya na tiempo, ayo na Lajiña, y linilisja, na gaegue san jalom y pechon tata, güiya jafanue jit nu güiya.
LLM_Translation: I manunao siha naita i God i maneng-mana; i Anak na iisa na na’ana i bosom i Papa, siha na’itok i manunao.

Source: Then Pilate entered into the judgment hall again, and called Jesus, and said unto him, Art thou the King of the Jews?
Reference: N 18 33 61330 ¶ Entonses si Pilato tumalo jumalom gui palasyo ya jaagang si Jesus ya ilegña nu güiya: Jago jao y Ray Judio sija?
LLM_Translation: Na’ma’ si Pilato iha’ hallu’ di’ hukuman, un’ana’ si Jesus, un’ana’ giya: “Gima’ yu King di’ Hudiu?”

Source: Wherewith thine enemies have reproached, O LORD; wherewith they have reproached the footsteps of thine anointed.
Reference: Ni y enimigumo mannanamamajlao, O Jeova: ni y enimigumo munamamajlao y pinecat y pinalaemo.
LLM_Translation: Iyao na i enemigu siha i maprueba; iyao na i maprueba i tapok i anointed-ta, O LORD.

Source: Don't let those who wait for you be shamed through me, Lord Yahweh of Armies. Don't let those who seek you be brought to dishonor through me, God of Israel.
Reference: Chamo ayo sija y numananggajao munafanmamamajlao pot guajo, O Jeova, Yuus y inetnon sendalo: chamo ayo sija y umaliligaojao umadesonra pot guajo, O Yuus Israel.
LLM_Translation: Håo’ na’ma’ i manmangga’ hao’ iya’ para iya’ si Lord Yahweh of Armies, håo’ na’ma’ i manmangga’ hao’ iya’ para iya’ si God of Israel.

Source: He spake unto them in the cloudy pillar: they kept his testimonies, and the ordinance that he gave them.
Reference: Güiya cumuentutuse sija gui jalom y jaliguen y mapagajes: sija umadaje y tinagoña, yan y otden ni y mannae sija.
LLM_Translation: Siña’ i manmanglo’ i pilaaru i ma’pula: tinatagu’ i testimonia’ i ordinasion i manmanglo’ para i manmanglo’ na’ i patten.

Source: For he will deliver you from the snare of the fowler, and from the deadly pestilence.
Reference: Sa güiya unninalibre guinin y lason y tiradot, yan guinin y yinilang peste.
LLM_Translation: Håo’ iha’ para bai ha’å’yu’ i yo’ i snare i fowler, yan para bai ha’å’yu’ i yo’ i patgon i ma’å’å’ i pestilence.

Source: With the pure thou wilt shew thyself pure; and with the froward thou wilt shew thyself froward.
Reference: Ya y gasgas unfanue na gasgasjao: ya y camten unfanue na camtenjao.
LLM_Translation: Håo puru iha’ puru; yan håo froward iha’ froward.

Source: The Spirit of the Lord is upon me, because he hath anointed me to preach the gospel to the poor; he hath sent me to heal the brokenhearted, to preach deliverance to the captives, and recovering of sight to the blind, to set at liberty them that are bruised,
Reference: Y Espiritun y Señot gaegue gui jilojo, sa japalae yo para jupredica y mauleg na sinangan gui mamobble: ya matago yo para jusangane mancautibo, linibre, ya para y manbachet ufanmanlie, ya para junafanlibre y manchiguit,
LLM_Translation: I Spiritu i Senhior i na’ot i manåo, si’ i anointed i manåo para i’preche i gudu na’ i manåm; i’ sendåo i manåo para i’ heal i hatåo na’ i na’kakåo, para i’preche i deliverånsia na’ i na’kakåo, para i’ recover i sight na’ i na’kakåo, para i’ set i libertåi i na’kakåo na’ i na’bruisåo.

Source: Praise him with tambourine and dancing! Praise him with stringed instruments and flute!
Reference: Alaba güe ni y pandireta, yan y dansa: alaba güe ni y gaecuetdas na dandan yan y flauta.
LLM_Translation: Håfa i manmanu i? tamburina yan manångåo! Håfa i manmanu i? instrumentu yan flauta!

Source: The God of this people chose our fathers, and exalted the people when they stayed as aliens in the land of Egypt, and with an uplifted arm, he led them out of it.
Reference: Y Yuus este na taotao iya Israel, jaayeg y mañaenata, yan jajatsa y taotao sija anae mañasaga taegüije y taotao juyong guiya Egipto, ya ni y taquilo na canaeña jacone sija juyong güije.
LLM_Translation: I Lahi i taotao giya, na pili i tatatåmon-tao, ya na taotao i taotao i manångåo i alienu i tano Egipto, ya ma’ångåo i limå i manå’åo, na fachi’ i manångåo i må’åo i tano-mu.

Source: With my lips have I declared all the judgments of thy mouth.
Reference: Contodo y labiosso jagasja jusangan claro todo y juisio sija y pachotmo.
LLM_Translation: Iyao i lips ko, guin-deklara i tanan na hujudu i sungo mo.

Source: Fill their faces with shame; that they may seek thy name, O LORD.
Reference: Nabula y matañija ni y dinesonra: para sija ujaaligao y naanmo, O Jeova.
LLM_Translation: Håfa iha’ i faces-hu i shame; para iha’ i seek thy name, O LORD.

Source: One of the Pharisees invited him to eat with him. He entered into the Pharisee's house, and sat at the table.
Reference: N 7 36 45480 ¶ Ya malago uno gui Fariseo sija na ufañija mañocho. Ya jumalom gui guima y Fariseo ya matachong gui lamasa.
LLM_Translation: Ha na’ma’gas na’ siha na Fariseo, i invite-na i manmå’lu. I gima’ i balay na Fariseo, un sit i taula.

Source: and certain women who had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities: Mary who was called Magdalene, from whom seven demons had gone out;
Reference: Ya palo sija famalaoan ni guinin nanafanmagong ni manaelayen espiritu yan y chetnot sija; si Maria ni mafanaan magdalena ni jumuyong guiya güiya siete na manganite,
LLM_Translation: Håfa i manångåo na babayi, i manångåo i espiritu siña yan i kinala: si Maria, i tinatawag si Magdalene, i manångåo i pito demonyu i ginenåo na;

Source: Joseph of Arimathaea, a prominent council member who also himself was looking for the Kingdom of God, came. He boldly went in to Pilate, and asked for Jesus' body.
Reference: Mato si José, taotao Arimatea, mauleg na taotao na pápagat, ni y jananangga locue y raenon Yuus; ya mapos yan atrebe malag as Pilato, ya jagagao y tataotao Jesus.
LLM_Translation: Si Jose of Arimathaea, un miembro prominente del konsilu, na siña manmasecho i Kingdom of God, pot iña. Na pot iña iña si Pilato, na manhiling i lawas ni Jesus.

Source: Now as he spoke, a certain Pharisee asked him to dine with him. He went in, and sat at the table.
Reference: N 11 37 47590 ¶ Ya mientras cumuecuentos, un Fariseo siniplicagüe na usija chumocho, ya jumalom ya matachong gui lamasa.
LLM_Translation: Nia, i taotao, un Phariseo siha i manmangga na i dine’ i manmangga. I manmangga, un siet i mesa.

Source: Not to all the people, but unto witnesses chosen before of God, even to us, who did eat and drink with him after he rose from the dead.
Reference: Ti para todo y taotao, lao para y testigo sija ni y manmaayeg antes as Yuus; junggan, para jita, ni y guinin manjita mañocho yan manguimen despues di cajulo guinin y manmatae.
LLM_Translation: Ayuyu na’ot i taotao, ma’å’ta i manmå’å’ na pinili’ i Dios, para i tå’åmi, ya’ i manmå’å’ ya’ i man’å’å’ gi’ i man’å’å’ na’å’ i patay.

Source: I have relied on you from the womb. You are he who took me out of my mother's womb. I will always praise you.
Reference: Sa jago mumantieneyo desde y jalom tuyan, jago chumuleyo juyong guinin y tiyan nana: ya y tininajo todo y tiempo guiya jago.
LLM_Translation: Håo i relya hao ti manåmagu, i hao i manåmagu i tinalåo i håo gima’ i sinåna. I will always praise hao.

Source: He said to the vine dresser, 'Behold, these three years I have come looking for fruit on this fig tree, and found none. Cut it down. Why does it waste the soil?'
Reference: Ya ilegña ni y lancheruña: Esta guaja tres años ni matoyo güine na trongcon igos, manegagayo tinegcha, ya taya nae mañodayo; utut papa; para jafa na jaocucupa y tano?
LLM_Translation: I taotao gi manam-ñi, “Siña, i manenglu na binti (tolu) años i haole’ parao’ i prum i figo na’ i haole’ i prum, pero i haole’ i prum. Håya’ i prum. Maole’ maole’ i tano’?”

Source: Most certainly I tell you, a servant is not greater than his lord, neither one who is sent greater than he who sent him.
Reference: Magajet ya magajet jusangane jamyo: Y tintago ti güiya magasña na y senotña; ni y matago, ti güiya magasña na y tumago güe.
LLM_Translation: Most certainly I tell you, a servant is not greater than his lord, neither one who is sent greater than he who sent him.

Source: Behold, and answer me, Yahweh, my God. Give light to my eyes, lest I sleep in death;
Reference: Jaso ya jungogyo, O Jeova, Yuusso: ina y atadogjo sija para mungayo maego gui maego finatae.
LLM_Translation: Siña, yan i-espónni hao, Yahweh, i Tåtao. I-llumina i mata-mu, para no hao matågai i patte;

Source: Destroy, O Lord, and divide their tongues: for I have seen violence and strife in the city.
Reference: Yulang, O Jeova, ya ipe y jilañija; sa jagasja julie y fijom na manaelaye, ya y manmanpotfifia gui siuda.
LLM_Translation: Siña, O Lord, unta i tongkåda: kayu haole i violensia yan i strife i siyudad.

Source: He sent darkness, and made it dark; and they rebelled not against his word.
Reference: Jatago y jemjom, ya ninajomjom; yan sija ti ninafanaguaguat contra y finoña.
LLM_Translation: Siña’ i dilak, yan siña’ i dilak; yan siña’ i rebela’ i palabra na.

Source: So when Pilate saw that nothing was being gained, but rather that a disturbance was starting, he took water, and washed his hands before the multitude, saying, "I am innocent of the blood of this righteous person. You see to it."
Reference: N 27 24 34700 ¶ Anae jalie si Pilato na taya jafa na probecho, lao mas y ninafanyaoyao, mañule janom ya jafagase y canaeña gui menan y taotao sija, ya ilegña: Taeisaoyo gui jâgâ este y tunas na taotao: lie jamyo.
LLM_Translation: Na’maole’ i Pilato, si’ no’ guaha na’gaige’ para, ma’ole’ na’gaige’ i maneng-mana’ i’ taotao, na’ta’otao’ i’ danum, ha’na’ i’ lima’ na’maole’ i’ atubangan i’ taotao, ha’na’ i’ na’ma’ina: “Hågu’ i’ maneng-mana’ i’ i’du’ i’ taotao ma’ole’ na’gaige’. I’yo’ i’ para.”

Source: They pour out arrogant words. All the evildoers boast.
Reference: Sija manmefno, sija sumangan sinaguat yan todo y chumochogüe y tinaelaye manbanidoso.
LLM_Translation: Mata’ i’ manengengeng na’ i’ manengengeng.

Source: Remember this, that the enemy hath reproached, O LORD, and that the foolish people have blasphemed thy name.
Reference: Jaso este, na y enimigo manmalalatde, O Jeova, ya ayo y mangaduco na taotao jachatfino y naanmo.
LLM_Translation: Manenggai siña, i enemi ginenatgue, O LORD, yan i pipi’ na’ma’gas ginenatgue i ngaran mo.

Source: I have come in my Father's name, and you don't receive me. If another comes in his own name, you will receive him.
Reference: Guajo mato yo pot y naan Tatajo, ya ti inresibe yo; yaguin otro mato pot y naanña namaesa, ayo inresibe.
LLM_Translation: Håo kumåo i ngaran i Tåta, yan håo si må resebi. Si otro kumåo i ngaran na siña, må resebi håo i hem.

Source: You gave me no kiss, but she, since the time I came in, has not ceased to kiss my feet.
Reference: Jago ti unnaeyo un chico: lao este na palaoan desde que jumalomyo ti pumapara jachico y adengjo.
LLM_Translation: Håo gi’åo siña’ i kiss, pero bibiha, depi i taotao hao, manmangga’ i feet håo.

Source: This gate of the LORD, into which the righteous shall enter.
Reference: Este na trangcan Jeova; anae, manjajalom y manunas.
LLM_Translation: Håo na puerta i SENIOR, i manåmgo’ para i matinas.

Source: When we had come to Jerusalem, the brothers received us gladly.
Reference: Ya anae manmatojam Jerusalem, mangosmagof y mañelo jaresibejam.
LLM_Translation: Gima’ mi Jerusalem, i brada’ siña’ i manmanglo’ i taotao.

Source: And when he was cast out, Pharaoh's daughter took him up, and nourished him for her own son.
Reference: Ya anae mayute, y jagan Faraon jumoca, ya pinegsae para lajiña.
LLM_Translation: Taotao siha, Pharaoh na’ i’ina, ha’it i’up i maneng-mana’ i’ina para i’ina na’ anak.

Source: And as the shipmen were about to flee out of the ship, when they had let down the boat into the sea, under colour as though they would have cast anchors out of the foreship,
Reference: Ya y marinero cumequefanmalago gui batco anae esta manatunog y bote gui tase, ya jinasonñija na siña ujayute y angcla gui proa.
LLM_Translation: Ika na’maole’ i menneno’ i barko, iha na’ma’papa’ i boat i segi, para iha na’ma’papa’ i anchura’ i fore-ship.

Source: Remember the word unto thy servant, upon which thou hast caused me to hope.
Reference: ZAIN sumaga dos años gui inatquilaña na guma; ya jaresibe todo ayo sija y manmato guiya güiya,
LLM_Translation: Håna i palåbra para i to’lo’ mo’na, i gima’ ha’åo’ håo’ håna’ håo’ i håna’ håo’ håo’.

Source: He healed many who were sick with various diseases, and cast out many demons. He didn't allow the demons to speak, because they knew him.
Reference: Ya janafanjomlo megae ni manestaba manmalango todo clasen chetnot sija; ya jayute juyong megae na anite sija; ya ti japolo nu y anite sija cumuentos sa matungo güe.
LLM_Translation: Himyo’ na’maole’ i maneng-mana’ na’maole’ i sakit, ha’ i demonyo, ha’ i demonyo, siña’ i maneng-mana’ na’maole’ i demonyo. I maneng-mana’ na’maole’ i demonyo, kayu’ na’maole’ i demonyo i taotao, siña’ i maneng-mana’ na’maole’ i demonyo.

Source: They departed quickly from the tomb with fear and great joy, and ran to bring his disciples word.
Reference: Ayo nae sija manapos gui naftan, manmaañao yan mangosmagof, yan manmalalago para umannae notisia y disipuluña sija.
LLM_Translation: Na-departa iha’ gima’ i libru’ na’ natte’ na’ fe’ iha’ taotao, un’ ran iha’ para i’bring iha’ i disipulu-na’ i’famagu’ i’yo’.

Source: Men's hearts failing them for fear, and for looking after those things which are coming on the earth: for the powers of heaven shall be shaken.
Reference: Manlalalango y taotao sija, pot y manmaañaoñija, yan pot y ninanangga ni ayo sija y manmamamaela para y tano: sa manmayengyong y ninasiñan y langet sija.
LLM_Translation: Maniha’ na’ puso’ i’ manengga’ para’ i’ takot, yan para’ i’ manengga’ i’ mga’ bagay na’ ma’kakattåo’ na’ guåhan i’ tano’: kay i’ kapangyarihan i’ langit ma’kakagåsto.

Source: Because of thine indignation and thy wrath: for thou hast lifted me up, and cast me down.
Reference: Sa pot y linalalomo yan y binibumo: sa jago jumatsayo yan yumuteyo.
LLM_Translation: Håfa i thine indignation yan i thine wrath: ta ha’ lifted me up yan ha’ cast me down.

Source: And when he was twelve years old, they went up to Jerusalem after the custom of the feast.
Reference: Ya anae guaja esta dose na años, sija mangajulo guiya Jerusalem taemanoja y costumbren y guipot.
LLM_Translation: Taotao iha doce åños, ginen iha Jerusalem para iha i custumbre i feista.

Source: And he charged them that they should tell no man: but the more he charged them, so much the more a great deal they published it;
Reference: Ya jaencatga sija, na chañija sumangangane ni jaye; lao mientras mas jaencatga, mas manamamto;
LLM_Translation: Unu na’ i charge i gima’ na’ i man: pero i mas na’ i charge, i mas na’ i gima’ na’ i publika’ i man.

Source: The lines are fallen unto me in pleasant places; yea, I have a goodly heritage.
Reference: Ya, y fottunajo upodong gui lugat na magof: magajet na bonito na ineredajo.
LLM_Translation: I liña’ i manhilu’ para i’ hao’ i lugat; iya, hao’ i manhilu’ na herensia.

Source: I will greatly praise the LORD with my mouth; yea, I will praise him among the multitude.
Reference: Jeova bae junae sendangculo na grasias nu y pachotto; junggan, jualabagüe gui linajyan taotao.
LLM_Translation: Håfa i praisao-mu na’å’åo LORD i må’åo; håfa, i praisao-mu iya na’å’åo i entre i manmåñåo.

Source: One thing have I desired of the LORD, that will I seek after; that I may dwell in the house of the LORD all the days of my life, to behold the beauty of the LORD, and to inquire in his temple.
Reference: Unoja na güinaja jugagao gui as Jeova, este jualiligao; na jugaegue gui guima Jeova todo y jaanen linâlâjo, para julie y guinatbon Jeova ya para jualigao gui temploña.
LLM_Translation: Håo siña’ i único na gimaole’ para i SENIOR, un na siña’ hao; para ha’åo na tumå’ i balay i SENIOR i manmå’ i å’åo, para ha’åo na bista i gimaole’ i SENIOR, yan para ha’åo na siña’ i templo na i SENIOR.

Source: Therefore let all the house of Israel know assuredly, that God hath made that same Jesus, whom ye have crucified, both Lord and Christ.
Reference: Polo ya todo y guima Israel ujatungo magajet, na si Yuus fumatinas güe y Señot yan Cristo; este uje y inatane gui quiluus.
LLM_Translation: Na’ iha’ na’ iha’ Israel, siguru, guaha i God na’ ha’me’ Jesus, i manmapa’ yo’ na’ i’kru’kru, kao Lord yan Cristo.

Source: And after six days Jesus taketh Peter, James, and John his brother, and bringeth them up into an high mountain apart,
Reference: DESPUES di y saes na jaane, si Jesus jacone si Pedro, yan si Santiago, yan si Juan cheluña, ya jacone julo gui un taquilo na finabeca, na sumajnge.
LLM_Translation: Haole i Jesus, iha na dia seis, gima’ Peter, James, yan Juan, i manaina na hermano, un’upet iha na ma’gas na bintana’ iha na lugat na ma’gas, parao.

Source: There arose therefore a questioning on the part of John's disciples with some Jews about purification.
Reference: Ya guaja un inaguaguat entre sija yan y disipulon Juan yan y Judio sija pot y guinasgas.
LLM_Translation: Iya na, na-frage i disipulo si Juan para iha guaha na iha’ iha’ iha’ na purifikasion.

Source: Barnabas planned to take John, who was called Mark, with them also.
Reference: Ya si Barnabé malago na ujacone gachongñija si Juan, ni y apiyiduña Marcos.
LLM_Translation: Barnabas siña planu atu haña si Juan, na’ i maneng Mark, para iha’ yan iha’ siha.

Source: For these things were done, that the scripture should be fulfilled, A bone of him shall not be broken.
Reference: Sa este na güinaja jumuyong esta para umacumple y tinigue na ilegña: Ni un tolang guiya güiya umajulog.
LLM_Translation: Para i manmangon i taotao, para i kasulatan i matuod, un i butiña na siña: “Håya un i butiña na siña.”

Source: And they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and began to speak with other tongues, as the Spirit gave them utterance.
Reference: Ya sija todo manbula ni y Espiritu Santo, yan jatutujon sumangan y otro na finijo, taegüijija y Espiritu numae sija na ujasangan.
LLM_Translation: Ya nafillo’ i Espiritu Santo, unkumensan i man’otton tongan i tongan iha’ na’ i Espiritu para i man’otton.

Source: You love all devouring words, you deceitful tongue.
Reference: Unguaeya todo y mannanataelaye na sinangan: O, dacon na jula.
LLM_Translation: Gustá yu tanan i tinataotao na mga pulong, i diksirát na dila.
